title: 第十四章 几百元廉价长发，头发里爬满噬魂黑虫
novel_title: 救命！我的神煞师父怎么天天亲我
content_zh:
说完，往他眉间轻轻一点，傅烬川眼眸中竟真的看到丝丝黑气。

    卧室里光线昏暗，窗帘关着只留了一条缝隙。

    床上坐着两个女孩，其中一个满脸泪痕，包着纱布的右手紧握着身边人的手，正在和她说着什么。

    另一个女孩长发及腰，目光呆滞地望着前方一动不动。

    别人眼中乌黑发亮的秀发，在他们眼中却散发着墨绿色的光，鬼气萦绕，配上那张惨白的脸，显得阴森可怖。

    “文巧，这是姜大师，我请她来替小若看看，医院去了，药也吃了，你看她整天呆坐着不见起色，实在是没办法了，总要都试试才行。”

    文巧神情落寞，起身来到门口，对姜无念点了点头，“姜大师，我是伊若的好朋友，在学校和她几乎形影不离，有什么您问我就行。”

    言语客气，但神情明显不信任。

    姜无念毫不在意，指了指王伊若的头发，声音清冷：“她的头发哪里来的？”

    没想到大师一眼看到重点，文巧有些诧异，心里却开始佩服，连忙认真道：“伊若自从接了这些头发，整个人的行为状态都开始变得不正常。”

    姜无念挑了挑眉，目光直视她的手，“你手上的伤也是被她伤的吧。”

    王伊若的头发和文巧伤口上全都爬满了鬼气化成的黑色虫子，正啃噬着她们的血肉，密密麻麻的，想不看见都难。

    傅烬川不禁皱起眉头，看到黑色的虫子，有那么一瞬，他都怀疑自己在做噩梦。

    拉开书桌旁的椅子坐下，调整成一个舒服的姿势，姜无念对傅烬川招了招手，示意他靠近些。

    得让这小灵丹离近些，等下耗了灵力也好及时补补。

    “是，姜大师果然厉害。”看着自己受伤的手，文巧回忆起不久前发生的事情。

    几个月前，王伊若接完头发回到宿舍，才见到文巧就拉着她的手，满脸兴奋。

    “文巧！你看才几百块就能接这么长的头发，是不是很划算！可惜你今天要去兼职，不然我肯定得拉上你一起。”

    “好看好看！伊若你真的很适合长发，明天表白肯定能成功。”

    “我谢谢你奥，你什么人我不知道啊，别打趣我了，快来给我编几个造型，我好搭配衣服。”

    “好。”

    看着她兴奋的样子，文巧也替她高兴，拿起梳子准备帮她整理头发。

    可还没梳几下，王伊若忽然转过身来，面目狰狞，声音嘶吼，“别碰我的头发！”
content_en:
After saying that, he gently tapped his eyebrows, and Fu Jinchuan actually saw a trace of black energy in his eyes.

    The light in the bedroom was dim, and the curtains were closed leaving only a gap.

    There were two girls sitting on the bed. One of them had tears on her face. Her right hand wrapped in gauze was holding the hand of the person next to her, and she was talking to her.

    The other girl had long hair reaching her waist and stared blankly ahead, motionless.

    In other people's eyes, the shiny black hair exudes a dark green light, lingering with ghostly aura, and paired with the pale face, it looks eerie and terrifying.

    "Wen Qiao, this is Master Jiang. I asked her to come and take a look at Xiaoruo. She went to the hospital and took medicine. You see she has been sitting around all day without any improvement. There is really nothing we can do. We have to try everything."

    Wen Qiao looked lonely. She stood up and came to the door. She nodded to Jiang Wu Nian, "Master Jiang, I am Yi Ruo's good friend. I am almost inseparable from her at school. Just ask me if you have any questions."

    The words were polite, but the look on his face was clearly distrustful.

    Jiang Wunian didn't care, pointed at Wang Yiruo's hair, and asked in a cold voice, "Where does her hair come from?"

    Unexpectedly, the master saw the important point at a glance. Wen Qiao was a little surprised, but began to admire her in her heart. She quickly said seriously: "Ever since Yi Ruo got these hair extensions, her whole behavior has become abnormal."

    Jiang Wu Nian raised his eyebrows and looked directly at her hand, "The injury on your hand was also caused by her."

    Wang Yiruo's hair and Wenqiao's wounds were all covered with black bugs transformed from ghost energy, which were gnawing at their flesh and blood. They were so densely packed that it was difficult not to see them.

    Fu Jinchuan couldn't help but frown. When he saw the black bugs, for a moment, he suspected that he was having a nightmare.

    Pulling out the chair next to the desk and sitting down, adjusting to a comfortable position, Jiang Wu Nian waved to Fu Jinchuan, motioning for him to come closer.

    You have to keep this little elixir close, so that you can replenish it in time if the spiritual energy is used up later.

    "Yes, Master Jiang is really powerful." Looking at his injured hand, Wen Qiao recalled what happened not long ago.

    A few months ago, Wang Yiruo returned to the dormitory after getting her hair done. When she saw Wen Qiao, she took her hand and looked excited.

    "Wenqiao! You see, you can get such long hair extensions for only a few hundred yuan. Isn't it a good deal? It's a pity that you have to work part-time today, otherwise I would definitely have to drag you along."

    "You look good! Yi Ruo, you are really suitable for long hair. You will definitely succeed in confessing your love tomorrow."

    "Thank you. I don't know who you are. Stop teasing me. Come and give me some looks so I can match my clothes."

    "Okay."

    Seeing her excitement, Wen Qiao was also happy for her and picked up the comb to help her arrange her hair.

    But before combing it a few times, Wang Yiruo suddenly turned around with a ferocious face and shouted in a hoarse voice, "Don't touch my hair!"
title_en: Chapter 14: Cheap long hair worth a few hundred yuan, with soul-eating black worms crawling in the hair
